key.name: hold-ms
key.description: Released sooner = the button's own click; held longer = Super. Using another mouse button or the wheel while it is down turns it into Super at once.

key.name: overview-on-release
key.summary: Open Activities on a lone hold
key.description: Like the Super key on the keyboard: holding past the threshold and releasing without using it opens Activities.

key.name: fullscreen-is-game
key.summary: Treat every fullscreen window as a game

key.name: game-classes
key.summary: Extra window classes counted as games
key.description: Matched case-insensitively against the window class / app id, for native games the automatic detection misses.
